changes.title: Booking becomes three short steps with a progress bar
changes.why: Six fields at once is a lot and the section is taller than a laptop screen; one question per screen, a button that names the next step, and a way out for people who are not sure yet (rule 3k and the order-steps rule).

changes.title: Last booking step shows a summary before sending
changes.why: People see exactly what will be sent, Back works, and a missing date is covered by a tick for no date yet instead of an empty field (3s.17, 3s.18).

changes.title: What we make: one big photo beside the list that follows each row
changes.why: Now the photo is a small tilted thumb and the rows jump open and shut as you scroll; a list beside a photo should change the photo, and the section must fit one screen (3s.2, 3s.15, checklist 5).

changes.title: On a phone the list and its photo fit together and stay still
changes.why: Now the unlit words are too pale to read comfortably and the photo sits sideways at the edge; the proposed words are dark enough and every line is always shown.

changes.title: Our work fits one screen with the filters and photos together
changes.why: Now the gallery is taller than a laptop screen so you scroll past half of it; two tidy rows with a show-all button keep it on one screen (3c.12).

changes.title: Choosing an occasion no longer pushes the page up or down
changes.why: Now picking an occasion moves everything below it by up to 210 px; the grid keeps its space so nothing jumps (3s.2). The chosen filter also reacts when you point at it.

changes.title: Phone: filters become one swipeable row, gallery is much shorter
changes.why: Now the seven filters stack into four rows and the gallery is almost two screens tall; one row and six tiles first get people to the booking sooner.

changes.title: Photo station fits one screen and uses the same booking words
changes.why: Now the section is taller than a laptop screen and the button says a different word for booking than the rest of the page (one wording per purpose, checklist 3).

changes.title: Closing screen fits one screen, soft shadows everywhere
changes.why: The closing section and the booking card were taller than a laptop screen; buttons, cards and photos now share one light shadow instead of several dark ones (3s.3). The balloon name and popping stay as they are.

questions: Can you send the original, uncropped photos of your work? The ones we have are small, already cut into rounded shapes, and cannot be shown whole or larger.
Is 052-764-4973 on WhatsApp and also takes calls? We would label it that way next to the button.
How quickly do you usually reply to a booking message, and do you want a line about it?
Do you take a deposit or have a cancellation rule? If so we will say it beside the send button.
Do you want a short note of your story and a photo of you after the opening, so people meet the person behind the balloons?
You asked for no price on the page. Would you like a line such as 'price depends on the size, we reply with a quote' instead?
Is there one sentence about how you work (for example how long an arch takes) that you would like beside what we make?
checks_now: Real site: 8 sections taller than a laptop screen, 7 filter choices that move the page 19 to 210 px, one pressed state missing, the word list too pale to read comfortably; no motion problems.
